reviews.checked_passages: Section6.6 printed pp92–93, Definition6.6.3, Exercise6.6.7 and Lemma6.6.9; section8.2 printed pp127–128, full Theorem8.2.1 proof and Remark8.2.2. The later good/regular ultrafilter theory and continuous logic are excluded.
reviews.outcome: No confirmed source defect recorded in the adopted theorem. The corpus expands the compressed diagonal argument using literal finite-prefix conjunctions for coordinatewise nesting and normalizes the zeroth large set and zeroth task to the whole index set and top, so each finite cutoff has a defined maximum. Parameter representatives and the exact named-product identification are supplied. The countable-type theorem is separated from countable-language aleph-one saturation; no countable carrier or stronger saturation is inferred.
